about.persona: Fullstack Developer, Cybersecurity Researcher, Systems Architect, and Deep Technical Hunter actively securing client ecosystems and researching upstream vulnerabilities.
about.full_description:
I am a Fullstack Developer, Advanced Systems Builder, and Cybersecurity Researcher driven by deep technical inquiry and automated efficiency. I maintain active participation in client infrastructure security—providing continuous vulnerability triage, edge-level runtime hardening (mitigating Node.js CVE-2026-111497 Brotli RCE & Next.js 16.4.3 security updates), and verified zero-vulnerability postures for production client applications.

Beyond client systems, I am deeply active in bug hunting and upstream open-source core research, uncovering subtle parser differentials and query translation flaws in major ecosystems (such as WordPress Core's SQLite database integration). My work spans systems programming, low-level database internals, AI orchestration, local LLM tooling, and wireless network security using Python, Rust, Linux environments, and autonomous agent workflows.

projects.name: WordPress / SQLite Pattern Translation Research (Issue #568)
projects.description: Deep upstream research & bug discovery in WordPress Core's sqlite-database-integration. Identified a subtle SQL-to-GLOB translation flaw where literal '[' characters are mis-translated into SQLite GLOB character-class brackets, producing silent false-positive and false-negative row mismatches against MySQL LIKE semantics.
